course_name_original: MECCANICA DEI MATERIALI E PROGETTAZIONE MECCANICA I
course_name_en: MECHANICS OF MATERIALS AND MECHANICAL DESIGN I

learning_outcomes.text: Present the main laws and models of mechanical behavior of materials for mechanical components under static and dynamic loads.
Identify the causes of possible collapse and consequently adequate fatigue design.
Provide methodologies for mechanical design using classic and innovative materials such as composites and ceramics.
Provide methodologies for selecting and acquiring necessary data for the design of mechanical components and assemblies.
Develop design acumen through a year-long project concerning a complex mechanical transmission, proceeding with the dimensioning of machine construction elements in their entirety.
Ability to compare different solutions and establish the most suitable one.
Identify and illustrate the most convenient design choices.
Ability to integrate diversified sources (regulations, books, also in English, online videos, catalogs) for study.

syllabus_topics: High and low cycle fatigue (15 HOURS – 1.5 CFU)
Brittle and ductile materials (15 HOURS – 1.5 CFU)
Analysis and design of flexed beams (5 HOURS – 0.5 CFU)
Experimental analysis of deformations and stresses for material characterization and mechanical element design: extensometry, advanced optical techniques, non-destructive methods (5 hours -0.5 CFU)
Nomenclature of main mechanical machine parts; kinematic schemes (2.5 HOURS – 0.25 CFU)
Straight, helical, and bevel gears: calculation and verification procedures (12.5 HOURS – 1.25 CFU)
Axles and shafts: materials, static and fatigue strength, admissible deformations (15 HOURS – 1.5 CFU)
Hot and cold forced connections, keys, splines, bolts (15 HOURS – 1.5 CFU)
Springs: bending and torsion springs (2.5 HOURS – 0.25 CFU)
Single-plate and multi-plate clutches (2.5 HOURS – 0.25 CFU)
Rolling and hydrostatic bearings. Type, mounting criteria and dimensioning (5 HOURS – 0.5 CFU)
3-D representation and FEM analysis of mechanical components (5 HOURS – 0.5 CFU)
teaching_methods: Individual tutoring for the mandatory year project
Daily clarifications on topics covered in class upon student request
assessment_rules: Learning assessment evaluates the ability to design a mechanical assembly with material selection (practical test) and to explain theoretical concepts (theoretical test). The practical test involves submitting the year project before the oral exam, which will be graded out of thirty and will be averaged with the theoretical test score. A minimum score of 18/30 is required for the practical part to access the theoretical test. The theoretical test can be a written exam or an oral interview (60 min duration) aimed at ascertaining knowledge of fundamental theoretical concepts for mechanical design. A score of 30/30 cum laude indicates exceptional preparation.
bibliography: R. Giovannozzi: “Costruzione di Macchine”, Patron Editore
R.C. Juvinall, K.M. Marshek: “Fondamenti della Progettazione dei Componenti delle Macchine”, Edizioni ETS
